Erdoğan made a statement  yesterday after the cabinet meeting and  said that no one, including himself, is  above criticism. Yes. Now, let no one  get too excited. Everyone should stay  calm. Just because this statement was  made, let's not get too comfortable. We  live in such a democratic country.  Let's not get carried away. Uh, things  could turn out bad afterwards. Because  you know, a woman doing a street  interview can end up in prison, or a  journalist can find themselves in jail  the moment the President is insulted.  That's why let's not get into too much.  Let's not get carried away. Let's take  it slow. But since President Erdoğan  said that you can criticize everyone,  including me, we can use our right to  criticize a little. Isn't that right?  For example, you can say. There is a  fire in our kitchens right now. We go  to the grocery store. We return with an  empty bag. Because Erdoğan, unlike the  rest of the world, implemented an  interest rate policy during the  pandemic. Contrary to all economists  and all state administrations in the  world, he said he would lower interest  rates, and we continue to pay the price . Pensioners are hungry, they are poor.  Uh, young people cannot start a family.  Our children are stunted because they  cannot get enough protein, and there  are no resources for any investment in  the country. Except for the contractors . Money continues to be transferred to  contractors with guarantee payments.  But the country's economy is among the  worst in the world. We are also in the  top five in the world for inflation. So , I think we have the right to  criticize Erdoğan on this issue, right ? We can discuss this. We can say this  tirelessly, without getting bored.  Because the process we are going  through, based on his "I am an  economist" remark, is exactly the void  in our stomachs. Exactly the poverty in  our homes. That's why Erdoğan said you  can criticize me. Now, the bad part is,  Erdoğan said this, right? His inner  circle doesn't know about it. His inner  circle always says, "We won't let  anyone say a word against Erdoğan."  They call it our red line. Turkey is  talking about the biggest scandal in  world history and Turkish history—no,  the biggest scandal in Turkish history,  one of the biggest scandals in world  history—the fund corruption, the fund  fraud, the fund heist. So, while  talking about this fund heist, AKP  figures—that is, the names right next  to Erdoğan—the moment you say a word  about Erdoğan, they say the "Chief"  didn't know. Their devotion to the " Chief" is very sharp. They say the  Chief will solve this. They don't let  anyone speak against Erdoğan. That is  their general strategy. Now Erdoğan is  telling them too, "Look, I can be  criticized." We ask them to stay calm  as well. But as I said, you should  still be cautious. But, but that's what  they say. Politicians say things like  this. They appear humble like this.  Then a "but" comes after it. That "but"  also comes in Erdoğan's statement.  Look what he says. "No one, including  myself, is above criticism, but no  one's title gives them the right to  assassinate someone else's character  using FETÖ methods." Now this also  means that suddenly, after that "but,"  you could become a FETÖ supporter.  Just because you criticized him. That's  why it's useful to be cautious. You'd  better not touch Erdoğan like this  while Turkey is experiencing the  greatest corruption in its history.  Because as you know, Ömer Çelik had  made a statement. The AKP spokesperson,  who makes statements about every claim  except those about himself, said, "If  you say these things about Erdoğan, we  go into total struggle mode." Total  struggle, with the judiciary in their  hands, essentially with all state  resources and possibilities at their  disposal; what else would it be? They  can enter that struggle mode with  everything they have. Well, that "but"  sentence is a bit tricky, but let's  continue to ask anyway. Of course, it  is worth continuing to ask. For  instance, let us remind you that he  still hasn't spoken about Ömer Çelik.  As you know, Özgür Özel, the leader  of the main opposition party, said  Ömer Çelik went on a holiday in  Bodrum. With whom did he go on holiday?  With Osman Nacar. Who is Osman Nacar?  According to allegations, he is a  former bureaucrat turned company owner  who fled abroad after a 20 billion TL  fund fraud. And, well, the amount was  actually 81 million TL, and he had  deposited it back. So, the heist was an  81 million TL heist. That’s what he  said. And Ömer Çelik went on holiday  to Bodrum with him. And there is still  no response from Ömer Çelik regarding  Özgür Özel's question. Ömer Çelik  doesn't speak about this at all. I  suppose that means he is not to be  criticized. So, he cannot be asked  questions. Erdoğan is questioned.  Erdoğan himself can be criticized.  Ömer Çelik cannot be criticized. Why  can't he be criticized? Because for  reporting news about Ömer Çelik,  about Ömer Çelik being at Limak's  50th anniversary in Bodrum with Osman  Nacar. anniversary. Limak is also a  contractor, you know. One of these five  contractors. For publishing the photo  of them together at that Limak 50th  anniversary event, our colleague  Mustafa Balcı is in prison; so yes,  you can criticize. You can criticize,  and you go to prison. I think Ömer  Çelik is more untouchable than  Erdoğan. When you criticize him, young  reporters can be thrown into jail.  Şaban Sevinç, he had both shared the  photo, retweeted it, and brought some  allegations about Ömer Çelik to the  agenda. Şaban Sevinç is also in  prison; they were put in Maltepe prison . You can criticize. Everyone can be  criticized, but Ömer Çelik cannot be  criticized. But we will continue to ask , of course. As journalists, we will  continue to ask. Mr. Ömer, what is  your connection with Osman Nacar? Did  you go on holiday together with Osman  Nacar in Bodrum? Did you return on the  same plane? Did Osman Nacar give you  information about the fund fraud? Did  you know nothing at all about these  commercial relations of his? Was this  process that secretive? Where does your  closeness stem from? Does it stem from  his time as a bureaucrat? Do you have a  relationship from your time as a  bureaucrat? We have many questions like  this in mind, but you know it’s not  just Mustafa Balcı and Şaban Sevinç.  While even Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya  walks around freely during this fund  fraud, the journalists paying the price  are not limited to them. Murat Ağırel , you know. At the same time, İsmail  Saymaz, because they followed up on the  claims made by the deputy of the new  party, Ümit Özlale, in the General  Assembly of the Grand National Assembly  of Turkey, and because they commented  on them, they are under house arrest.  Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya doesn't have  that shackle. There is no electronic  ankle monitor on her leg. There is not  even footage of her arriving at the  courthouse. We only have small  anecdotes even from her testimony. They  are walking around freely with their  spouses despite having pulled off a 2.2  billion TL heist. Murat Arel is under  house arrest with an electronic tag on  his ankle, and İsmail Saymaz is also  under house arrest with an electronic  tag. You can already criticize the  entire process, by the way. You don't  report on it as a journalist. I’ll  set reporting aside for a moment. Just  imagine what would happen if they dared  to criticize it. I mean, reporting on  Ömer Çelik or publishing a photo is  grounds for going to prison; I guess  Erdoğan isn't told these things either . Regardless, the Ponzi heist, the  heist of the century. Erdoğan  apparently hasn't even heard of one of  the biggest corruption scandals in  world history, by far the biggest in  Turkish history. I suppose Erdoğan  also doesn't know that journalists are  in prison simply for reporting on Ömer  Çelik. That's why he says, "Everyone,  including myself, can be criticized."  We can't even report the news. Now look , very interesting developments are  taking place regarding the process here . Very interesting developments are  happening. Yesterday's development was  the news story published by Sabah  Newspaper. It was the story that Sabah  Newspaper covered. If Murat Arel,  İsmail Saymaz, Mustafa Balcı, Şaban  Sevinç, or we had published that story , I don’t know where we would have  woken up. Where would we have woken up?  But Sabah Newspaper published a  headline, a massive headline story.  They also put the story on their  website. And it's an Abdurrahman  Şimşek story. Abdurrahman Şimşek is  a partisan known to be very close to  Akın Gürlü, very close to the  Ministry of Justice, very close to the  judiciary, and even rumored to wander  in the deep corridors of the state. Now , according to the report he made— look, according to his report—between  September 1 and September 16, 440  investors pulled off a 401.3 billion TL  heist. In other words, they evaporated  401 billion TL. In 16 days. In just 16  days. One of the biggest robberies in  world history. One of the biggest  robberies in world history. Now, you  look at the news about this. It  contains some very important data.  There is some really significant data  inside. It says, according to the  report, that the heist committed by  these 440 people is a continuation of  that 214-person, 187 billion 653  million TL heist from three separate  funds. It is said to be a continuation  of that. We need to interpret this  number along with that one. We were  talking about 214 people. We kept  asking why you weren't disclosing those  214 people. Now we ask, why aren't you  disclosing these 440 people? Because  they didn't disclose them. They weren't  disclosed yesterday either. Just as  they haven't been for 3 weeks, they  still haven't been disclosed. Now, look , there is some very important  information inside. There are very  important details. This is the total  capital outflow from the Tera and  Pusula funds between September 1 and [ September 16]. Just two funds. This— don't you dare think like this. There  were 7 fund companies, right? There  were 7 portfolio companies, right? Not  all of them. Only Tera and Pusula. The  total capital outflow is 401 billion  267 million 791 thousand 742 lira. This  much has been identified. The number of  investors who withdrew 100 million TL  or more from the Tera fund during the  same dates—that is, in those 16 days —is 168. Look, there were 168 in Tera . The total amount these 168 investors  withdrew from the fund—brace  yourselves—is 335 billion 912 million  421 thousand 253 TL. So let's just say  it like this: they looted 336 billion.  They looted 336 billion in 16 days. We  feel so helpless in trying to explain  these numbers, these amounts of money,  dear viewers. We feel so helpless. I  mean, 336 billion is truly impossible  to describe. I mean, we cannot convey  how many trucks, schools, bridges,  highways, or hospitals could be built  with it. We truly cannot convey it. I  mean, we cannot describe the national  budget. These amounts of money are not  just any money. Look, this information  is based on the prosecutor's office  conducting the investigation. It is  based on the prosecution. These are the  findings of the prosecutor's office.  And more will follow. Look, as I  mentioned to TR on the same dates. On  the same dates, the number of investors  withdrawing 50 million TL or more from  the compass fund is 272. The total  amount these people withdrew from the  fund is 65 million. 65 billion, of  course, it was calculated as 65 billion  354 million 370 thousand 489 liras.  Thus, just two funds, when we add them  up, we reach 440 people and 401 billion  liras. We are reaching 401 billion  liras. Now, these are funds where they  exited with inside information, or  rather, where they prepared the scam  and inflated the stocks. Then, it's a  system where they go public through  state institutions to crash the funds,  and the moment people rush in, they  take the money and run. There are also  stock scammers involved in this as well . There are those who inflate those  stocks and scam people separately. They  are not these people. They are not  among them. These are the ones who  exited with prior knowledge from the  funds. Meaning, they are the ones  saying the fund will collapse, let’s  run. Now they say in the prosecutor's  statement and the Sabah Newspaper  report that if the investigative units  confirm the suspicion of information  leakage, the process is expected to  expand with new injunctions. Meaning,  it says that the assets of these 440  people will also be seized. Action will  be taken against them. It says these  investigations are ongoing. Now, this  is very important news. Not just  because it reveals this massive scandal . It is very important news because it  was published in Sabah Newspaper, that  is, in a pro-government newspaper.  Because this is news that also reveals  the conflict within the government.  Look, as I said before, if we reported  this—if Murat did, if İsmail did, or  leave that aside, if Mustafa Balcı,  who was jailed just for publishing a  photo of Ömer Çelik, did, or if  Şaban Abi, Şaban Sevinç, did—they  would be sent to prison at lightning  speed. I mean, they would face all  sorts of trouble, but this news is  being reported. Now, the fact that this  news is being reported also contains a  message. While some try to keep this as  a very, uh, isolated, small, corruption  case that won't shake the market, and  while they want to fit the event into  that framework in Erdoğan's general  texts and speeches, when a  pro-government newspaper, Sabah  Newspaper—the spearhead of the  pro-government media—reports this, it  is saying: It is not isolated. There is  huge, very huge corruption here. 41  billion TL evaporated in 16 days. And  it's very important for Sabah Newspaper  to say this. Otherwise, as I said, if  we were the ones to say it, we would  face all kinds of trouble, but this  move is presented as a very interesting  move. Let us add a small note here.  Look, the information in this headline  was in the state's possession 3 weeks  ago. Now, do not think that this  information was gathered, researched,  and collected over time. Very  meticulous examinations were conducted.  Officials and prosecutors didn't work  tirelessly like that. They didn't just  happen to obtain this information. No,  they got straight to the computers on  the very first day. Because is this all  recorded corruption? This is not like  the IMM case or other cases against  opposition municipalities, based on  stories without evidence, secret  witnesses, or effective remorse. You  can't just run an operation like that  and find no money while pretending you  did. These are not those kinds of  operations. That is why they keep  referencing those municipalities, but  it's nothing like that. That is a  completely empty tactic. The story here  is that everything is on record, and on  the day this fund first burst and  defaulted, Pusla and Tera logged into  the computers. They checked, grabbed  this data 10 minutes later, and said  that between September 1st and 16th,  without this filtering, 440 people had  carried out a 401 billion TL heist. It  is being announced now. It is being  announced specifically now. This is a  move. This is a move. Because, as we  always say in our show before the crow  has breakfast, in this entire system,  major crises create major opportunities  for those in power. Now, with this  information, someone is making a move,  trying to push others out of the system  and build power for themselves. That is  a very good thing. This is not a bad  thing at all. This is a very good thing . But anger is also building up in some  people. We will get to those parts in a  moment. Because there are counter-moves , too. There are counter-moves, too. So  don't you dare call this isolated or  anything like that. Don't call it  isolated at all. On the contrary, look,  we are living through a process where  this is clearly not isolated, where a  reckoning is needed, and moves are  being made for this reckoning. Well,  they did this now. It reflects a heist  of 401.3 billion TL by 440 people, it  is very clear now. They still haven't  released the list. The list is still  not there. We don't know the 214 people . Just as we didn't know the 214, now  we don't know the 440 people. In a  while, this will be 650 people. We  won't know them either. But I follow  the economists. The economists were  already saying these numbers existed.  They were already saying the numbers  would reach this point. It is very  interesting, really. It seems  economists make accurate predictions  when they look at the whole system and  run their estimates. Now, I want to  remind you here of one more fact. Those  who put this information forward are  not having this discussion. While 440  people were carrying out a 401 billion  TL heist, what was the state doing? For  example, what was the CMB doing? The  Capital Markets Board, isn't it? What  was the BRSA doing? What was the Borsa  Istanbul doing? Or what was the  Ministry of Treasury and Finance doing  regarding the economy? Because we know  that Treasury and Finance Minister  Mehmet Şimşek had already mentioned  it 11 months ago. Why did it just watch , or why didn't the state mechanism  intervene in this process until it  collapsed and defaulted? Why didn't  someone go to Erdoğan—for example,  they say Erdoğan didn't know. Mehmet  Şimşek and Akın Gürlük say, "We  did something in 2025." They say, "We  detected it, sent a letter to the CMB,  and so on." Why didn't they go to  Erdoğan and say, "Sir, there is a huge  heist going on here"? Isn't that a  question mark? Now, I have a scenario  regarding that question mark, but I  emphasize this. It is just a scenario.  Could those running this operation be a  structure within the state? Yeah. You  will say, could there be a villainous  scheme? You will say, Timur, you are  speaking naively. You are quite right.  Of course, it is a structure within the  state. It ran this whole system. It  keeps this system going. But that  structure within the state may have  convinced the entire economic world,  the institutions, and the units  responsible for auditing this business  that this is a state project. I don't  think this probability is low. I don't  think this probability is low. Because  look, I wrote a book called "Barons ' Island." I mean, as a result of the  asset peace programs enacted by the  government, I explained how all the  world's dirty money came to Turkey,  then the owners of that dirty money  followed, and how drug traffickers and  barons from Australia, New Zealand, the  Netherlands, England, Africa, Latin  America—from all over the world you  can think of—came to Turkey, and this  was an asset peace program. It was the  result created by the asset peace.  Because the government needed hot money , and for that hot money, it introduced  the asset peace, which would invite the  world's dirty money to Turkey, and this  was a system. The Süleyman Soylu era.  During the Süleyman Soylu era, dirty  money from all over the world came to  Turkey and was funneled into the system . Exactly at that time, citizenships  were distributed for 250,000 dollars,  and later for 400,000 dollars. Drug  barons also tried to obtain citizenship  in Turkey to avoid being extradited to  their countries due to Interpol red  notices. Some of them actually obtained  citizenship. They became citizens of  the Republic of Turkey. This also  benefited the construction sector. It  also helped the country as hot money.  Could someone have presented this  project, which we can actually group  under the name Tera, as a state project , just like the past applications of  the asset peace? Let's take it even  further. It really is a state project.  If they see themselves as the state, it  might indeed be a state project. Now,  we have to create a structure here to  explain why the institutions are not  functioning. Yes. In the presidential  system, all institutions have already  collapsed. Meritocracy has disappeared.  Whatever the Palace said, that happened . The Palace said, "Do not investigate. " They did not investigate. Even the  Minister of Treasury and Finance said  in November 2025, "I see the  manipulations, we see them." Even the  Minister of Treasury and Finance did  not have the power. And this heist  continued. And they say, "Well, the  Palace didn't know either.""Erdoğan  didn't know either." But look, Emre  Tezmen is the name at the very top of  the Tera fund. When I look at him, I  see this. When I look at his statements , I see this as well. He talks about a  "domestic and national" project. Of  course, he knows it's a lie. Of course,  he is aware that this is a fraud. Of  course, he is presenting it as if it  were a project. But while presenting it  as this project, he has a lot of data  at his disposal. The man is able to  access the Central Registry Agency. How  is he able to access it? Could that  door have been opened because it's  called a state project? Or Fecir Hanım , a presidential advisor, one of the  advisors to the Presidency...is somehow  involved in the management of Tera  Holding. Even if it's for a short time,  she is involved. Could that also have  been presented as a state project? Or  look, in the Tera management, the Tera  fund, the Tera Holding management, you  see former ambassadors. You see former  bureaucrats, right? They are everywhere . You constantly see names like these,  politicians from the AKP. Look, Fatma  Betül Sayan Kaya is there, you know,  she bought shares. Look, Hayati  Yazıcı's son, Mustafa Yazıcı, is  wandering among the funds. Look at  Nihat Zeybekci. These are all AKP  deputy chairmen, the AKP headquarters.  They are roaming around there, could an  atmosphere of a state project have been  created there? When you see these names , I suppose you would say so. Or Erdin  Özel, right? Along with Fatma Betül  Sayan Kaya, they are roaming around  Ankara's backrooms and many places in  the headquarters. Could they have been  talking about a state project in many  places? The project is this: dirty  money, corruption money, the world's  criminal money, perhaps all that money  or illegal betting money, a source, hot  money, that can be laundered, will be  laundered, and where company shares can  be inflated to show activity on the  stock exchange, a sense of relief in  the market. The most needed, the most  important for the economy. Because  there are no foreigners left on the  stock exchange. There are no foreign  investors left in the country. The  solution to this, look, when Emre  Tezmen bought Pusula, that acquisition  of the Pusula management is very  suspicious. I hope one day we will  learn that too. The moment Pusula  defaulted, Tera said, "We bought it."  Under whose instructions did they buy  it? Why did they buy it? Then it  crashed itself anyway. It was going to  crash itself anyway. But could this  have happened there? Tera says, "We  created the local and national economic  finance model of this country's true  children," Emre Tezmen claims in that  statement, and argues that they have  transitioned to a new finance model  with the president's independent  character and his team's emphasis on  independence. Could they have told this  to everyone? And could they have  presented this as a state project? And  could this have turned into a massive  money laundering cycle, for example?  That's why, you know, the SPK chairman  says "shh, be quiet" so small investors  buy the shares; could this have emerged  as a state project? Look, this is a  scenario I am mentioning. But for this  scenario, for this cycle to cause 100  billion dollars of damage to this  country's economy, the path to such a  scale needs to be this big. It needs to  be under the mask of a state project.  No one would take this risk. It is all  full of moves by greedy people, or " jackals" in quotation marks, trying to  hit the jackpot or make off with the  money within that state project and the  "true children of this country" local  and national project. And being this  intertwined with politics and  bureaucracy fits this scenario right  here. Perhaps a clique. You know, we  said a one-man regime, but there are  dozens of cliques around the one-man  regime. All of them entered a path.  Some partnered up, some split, some  made the killing. They made a huge  killing. Exactly at this point, a  question. Why are 214 people not being  disclosed? Why are 440 people not being  disclosed? After a while, we will ask  this question. Why are 650 people not  being disclosed? Is it not being  disclosed because it is presented as a  state project? Is it not being  disclosed because if it were, the  entire system would be exposed? If you write something  about Tera, you are finished. Now, all  of this points to that scenario. So,  who organized this? The place where  this organization will be exposed is  those lists, and those lists are not  being disclosed. That is why they are  not being disclosed. As long as they  are not disclosed, the idea that this  is a state project grows stronger. The  rumors are gaining momentum. The story  is beginning to tie into the very top.  Some people come out and react. Oh, you  are saying that everyone is talking now . Erdoğan spoke, too. His deputy also  spoke. Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz  also spoke. He said that public  resources would not be used. Let’s  see, are they not being used? Look,  there is a statement regarding this;  recently, an economist, Nazır Kapusuz,  made a statement. He said a list, I had  even mentioned it to Eren. He published  a table. Now, uh, Nazır Kapusuz  analyzed this, and it’s not very  important, you know, Katılım Evim was  transferred to Emlak Katılım. There  was Serdar Turan, who bought mansions  in Greece, villas in Dubai, and not  stopping there, bought private jets,  private yachts, and constantly took  people on Umrah with private jets. He  is also actually very connected to the  Nurcu community. The Nurcu community,  everything is there. I mean, look,  there are sects in this story. There is  the mafia in this story. There are  politicians in this story. There are  bureaucrats in this story. This is the  point where all the evils of the system  converge. Now, they bankrupted  Katılım Evim too. Katılım Evim was  then shoved off onto Emlak Katılım.  Emlak Katılım has now bought 1.5  billion shares of Katılım Evim from  Tera. Now we say, no public resources  will be taken. There will be no outflow  from the public. Well, we are paying  for it. Serdar Turhan, the Nurcu, who  took Cübbeli Ahmet's son-in-law to  Umrah, and not content with that,  hauled around all those old preachers  and such. Forget it, Cevdet Yılmaz is  just talking. We, as the public, are  paying for the money Serdar Turhan  embezzled from Katılım Ev, while the  Vice President participates in opening  ceremonies with him. I mean, you never  entered the stock market, nor did you  join any funds. You don't even have the  money to invest in stocks or funds. How  do you expect to make ends meet at the  butcher and the grocery store? Now,  take that Serdar Turhan, the one who  goes on pilgrimages in his private jet.  You are paying for the damage he has  caused to this country. Then they claim  that public resources will not be used.  Well, here is the chart showing that  they have been used. Look, Emlak  Katılım bought 1.5 billion, and a  public institution bought 1.5 billion  in participation shares from Tera. 12  billion TL. Sales were also made  through Pusula. Then you see Nazır  Kapusuz comment that Emlak Katılım  will buy shares for 12 billion in just  2-3 days. Thus, 24 billion TL of public  funds will be transferred to the pool,  and he asks why this still isn't making  headlines. You, we, never entered the  stock market. You are paying for  bridges you never crossed and highways  you never used. Now you are going to  pay for the money swindled by these  Tera and Pusula profiteers. You are  paying 24 billion. 24 billion. Then  they say the process will be managed  transparently. that no public resources  will be used in the process. Isn't  Emlak Katılım a public entity? Isn't  it public? As I said, they are being  used, and now there are conflicts  within the AKP during this process.  There is also tension within the AKP.  Interesting voices continue to come  from there. Interesting moves continue  to emerge. Now, you know Ahmet Şık, a  TİP deputy, an Istanbul deputy. He  prepared an interesting news report. Or  rather, he announced some interesting  news. He said Furkan Torlak was  dismissed. Who is Furkan Torlak? He is  the closest person to Minister of  Justice Akın Gürlek. He is the one  who, in a sense, manages his media and  communication relations. Now, Furkan  Torlak is actually a name we recognize,  a name the public knows. How is he a  recognizable name? There was the Mehmet  Akif Ersoy investigation, you know. The  Editor-in-Chief of Habertürk.  Operations involving prostitution and  drugs were carried out targeting him.  It was revealed that he had been on  duty abroad together with Furkan Torlak . Furkan Torlak's name had appeared in  some testimonies, but he had made this  statement. I did not witness any of  these prostitution or drug-related  matters. There was no such statement  against him anyway. There was no  testimony regarding him. But then Cem  Küçük appeared on a broadcast on  TGRT and said about Furkan Torlak, "The  house you live in in Ankara is 40  million liras, the car you drive is 10  million liras." He said, "We know what  kind of schemes you are running through  Menekçi Construction." We even have  the documents. It is known that you are  snatching up lands. He said they create  a pool by claiming intelligence reports  have been prepared even about ministers . They prepare negative reports about  these people by saying "The President  wanted it like this" and distribute  them around. They are trying to  intimidate the ministers, Cem Küçük  had said. Now, as you know, Cem  Küçük is in prison. Now these  allegations, meaning these allegations  against Furkan Torlak, had come to the  agenda, and after these allegations, he  actually left his positions in the  Directorate of Communications. But look , despite this reaction, despite the  period when that Mehmet Akif Ersoy  scandal broke, he had de facto become  the person managing the press  consultancy and the media side of  Minister of Justice Akın Gürlek. Look , despite these reactions, they still  didn't give up on him. Now Ahmetçik  says that Furkan Torlak has been  removed from his post. He says Furkan  Torlak has been dismissed. Since he is  a name very close to Akın Gülle, this  naturally raises the question of  whether this is a move against Akın  Gülle. Analyses regarding this are  being made, and various rumors are  circulating about whether this is  related to the fund scandal. But as we  said, these are rumors, yet it must be  noted that this is indeed a significant  development. We asked a few sources as  well. They provided information  confirming this, but let us underline  that it is an allegation, as there is  no official statement. Now, of course,  look, all of this is happening. While  experiencing all this, such objections  continue to come from within the AKP in  Turkey. Reactions continue to come from  former figures, especially from former  AKP names. Another interesting name  among them joined the caravan today.  Orhan Miroğlu made a very harsh  statement. He says the date these  people infiltrated the AKP and formed  alliances in political and bureaucratic  institutions is the date the AKP began  to lose altitude. He says the  liquidation of the political cadres  that truly made the AKP the AKP began  one by one after these people haunted  the party. In other words, he is  entering into a reckoning. He is saying  that these fund-takers are actually a  clique and that they emerged after the  old AKP founding cadres were purged. He  says the party lost its status as  Turkey's primary party and the primary  party of the Kurds in Republican  history. (Continued from previous)... party, he says. I mean, look, he says  they started by corrupting the  information channels reaching the  president and state institutions with  disinformation. He says they were  actually both blind and deaf, but they  came together and hosted each other. I  mean, he says very harsh things, and  then he says: While this fund scandal  is going on, a Kurdish MP, a name  closely interested in the AKP and the  Kurdish issue, Miroğlu, says: In such  a process, as long as there is a fund  heist, while there is plunder, you  cannot expect anyone to believe in a  resolution process or a new  constitution. he says. Meaning he says  there is a massive robbery. He says  there is wreckage, but this is also a  historic opportunity for the AKP and  Turkey to purge its insides. Not to " purge the bowels" in the way that might  bring Bülent Arınç and the Ergenekon  plots to mind. But this time, I think  he means something else; he is calling  for a cleansing, a purification within  the AKP. That is why, as he connects it  to the process, there are very  interesting developments regarding the  process in particular. Now, it is very  interesting, truly very interesting.  Look at it this way. The Kurdish issue,  Turkey's bleeding wound for 50 years,  is a problem for which this country has  paid the heaviest prices, lost our  lives, and suffered great pain. Now,  progress is being made toward the  resolution of this issue. Progress is  being made, but the country is not  interested in it. The country is unable  to pay attention to it. Perhaps the  country cannot focus on this for this  reason. Scandals never cease in the  country. There is no end to  anti-democratic practices in the  country, and because there is constant  chaos, Turkey cannot channel itself  into this resolution process. It cannot  discuss it sufficiently, and a process  that is top-down, non-transparent, and  disconnected from the public is  underway in society. An important step  has been taken there now. Certain  videos have arrived from security  sources. Now I will ask Eren. Look,  four caves are being mentioned. Look,  they called it the so-called Jajak cave . I suppose it is pronounced Yaajk.  These caves are caves that have been  emptied. I mean, as you know, the PKK  has dissolved itself. They said we are  laying down arms, and evacuating the  caves in Iraq, Northern Iraq, near  Turkey, was part of this. I mean, it  was within this scope. Now these are  images sent by security sources, not by  the PKK. Now you see them like this,  these caves, look, the Hebat cave. Now  we see there as well, images taken with  drones and helicopters. These images  also contain the determination that the  caves have been evacuated, and these  were released. These were released by  security sources. Now, while security  sources were releasing these, they also  shared a text. A truly interesting text . It says the PKK/KCK has evacuated the  four shelters in the Metina field, Bazi  region in northern Iraq, namely Hebat,  Yaşk, Sabri, and Sason, as of October  8, 2026. Look, the PKK members burning  the materials inside......images are  also being shown. And after mentioning  the evacuation of these caves, I am  talking about the text that came from  security sources. Following the  termination of all PKK/KCK activities  in all areas, social consensus will be  reached with organization members who  will return to our country by  benefiting from the law in the later  stages of the process. It says social  consensus will be reached. It is aimed  to ensure the integration of PKK/KCK  members into society through integrated  programs to be carried out in many  areas such as education and the economy . In other words, security sources are  clearly demonstrating a will regarding  a solution; all segments of society, on  the basis of Turkish-Kurdish  brotherhood, will join hands and live  together in peace and tranquility in  every corner of our country. This is  the information from security sources.  Look, there are also images of the  caves being emptied in the footage. So,  what is this story? It started, as you  know, 2 years ago with Devlet  Bahçeli's call. Look, the images here  are also really interesting. I mean,  images of camps being emptied and  materials being thrown out. Well, after  that call by Bahçeli, 2 years have  passed, and as you know, a framework  law was enacted. Following the  framework law, there is this in the  text. It says the MGK (National  Security Council) will make a  determination. The PKK has now laid  down its arms. It has destroyed the  weapons. It has surrendered them. It  has dissolved itself. And after this,  once this law is published in the  Official Gazette with Erdoğan's  signature, within 6 months, an amnesty  for PKK members coming from abroad or  those inside Turkey, meaning in a way,  supervised release for 5 or 10 years,  it varies. Processes for their release  will take place. There are various  standards related to this as well. Now  this is why it is critical and a  threshold. Because this decision is  expected to be announced at the  National Security Council on November  27. I mean, the National Security  Council will convene. It will say the  PKK has given up now. There is no PKK  anymore. It has dissolved. They will  say we have laid down arms and emptied  the caves, and we confirm this, and the  process will proceed that way. The  framework law will start to be  implemented that way. Now, the release  of these images regarding this shows  that a threshold has been crossed. Even  Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz said it  doesn't necessarily have to be November  27; it could even be sooner. But  simultaneously with this, statements  are coming from the PKK as well. I mean , from the dissolved PKK. I mean,  Karayılan is speaking there. He says,  I mean, he says they always talk about  weapons, weapons, but they don't talk  about peace. He has such complaints,  but he also says this. We also gave the  order to withdraw our special forces,  whom the Turkish state fears most and  has demanded we withdraw from the  Istanbul metropolis and Turkish cities.  These are not people who were brought  out with fanfare. They are on a secret  mission. We took them out. We did this.  I mean, he says we had things like this  in Istanbul, in the metropolises. I  mean, we had our special forces. The  state was uneasy about this. And we  withdrew them from there, he says. They  were on a secret mission, he says. I  mean, this interview was published on  October 11th. He talks about the camps,  the caves I mentioned, being emptied,  and that footage of these has been  provided. But he says, look, there is a  lot there. Look, they also ask  Karayilan something. He confirms that  PKK delegations are meeting with state  officials. He says, "Yes, we are  meeting with state officials. This is  already known. He does not confirm the  allegations that some PKK leaders are  meeting directly with Öcalan in Imrali ." I mean, he doesn't say it's true, he  doesn't say it's a lie, but he doesn't  confirm it. I mean, he talks about it  in the same way here. Look, we also  have an explanation from the PKK, the  dissolved PKK has made a statement.  They always emphasize this. Öcalan has  not been freed. Öcalan has not been  freed. They have statements saying that  this process will not work without  Öcalan being freed. Now there, again  in the same way, after mentioning the  emptying of the caves, they also  criticize the framework law. They say,  okay, the law was passed, the law is  important, but there has been no  progress, and they talk about Öcalan  being freed. They talk about giving him  a status. In the same way, you know,  Devlet Bahçeli also talks about that  status. After that status is given, the  demand is conveyed for Öcalan to meet  with academics, journalists, and  various politicians in Imrali, and to  appear before the public. Now, look,  there is something very critical there.  I mean, from the moment Öcalan appears  before the public, and from the moment  the statements, the images, and the  interviews there emerge, what kind of  process can proceed in Turkey? Since a  sufficiently transparent process has  not been put before the public and  explained to them, could that process  create anger, an even greater anger? I  mean, is the Turkish public ready to  encounter an Öcalan? There are really  big question marks about this. Because  up to this point, there were great  opportunities. I mean, this process  could have been explained. It could  have been expressed better. It could  have been put before the public more.  It feels like this was not done much.  It is seen as not being conducted  transparently. But precisely at this  point, look, there is a question mark  in society regarding perceiving where  this whole process is going. Because  there is also a text that is the head  of this process, the beginning of this  process. A commission was established  in the parliament for it, and in that  commission's report, it was said:  Turkey will democratize with this  process. At the same time,  Constitutional Court decisions and ECHR  decisions will be implemented. I mean,  they already need to be implemented,  but it sets a will that they will be  implemented. I mean, I always say this  as Timur: It's like saying I won't kill  anyone. Of course, you will comply. If  you are a member of the ECHR, you will  comply with the decision. Uh, if you're  not a member, you won't comply anyway.  But there is no such thing as being a  member and not complying with its  decisions. Or there is no such thing as  complying with Constitutional Court  rulings. You either abolish the  Constitution or you comply with the  rulings, right? But Can Atalay will  continue to be kept in prison. Mine  Özer, Tayfun Kahraman, Osman Kavala,  Selahattin Demirtaş, Çiğdem Mater.  They will continue to remain in prison.  So it is not being implemented. It is  not being implemented. Now, while all  of this remains unimplemented, everyone  is asking this question. Is there a  bargain behind all of this, behind this  whole process, that would pave the way  for Erdoğan to become president again?  Every side, AKP, MHP, DEM Party, and  PKK, said there is no bargain. They  have always said this. So, it means  there is no bargain or anything of the  sort. But now, everyone's suspicion was  this. Could a constitutional amendment  or an early election decision be made  that would take the DEM Party's votes  and pave the way for Erdoğan to be a  presidential candidate again? Could  there be a process where the DEM Party  joins the People's Alliance and  supports Erdoğan? Could such a bargain  exist? Now, they asked Cengiz Çandar,  and they asked if the DEM Party would  support Erdoğan. He said that if a  promise of equal citizenship is given,  then the situation could be evaluated.  Look, it's actually exactly like this.  He is talking about Erdoğan's  candidacy again. He says if the party  is needed—meaning if Erdoğan needs  the DEM Party's votes in the seat  balance or in the arithmetic of votes,  or if a constitutional amendment is  promised that removes the obstacles  that deny Kurds equal citizenship and  block education in their mother tongue —then the situation will be  considered. Now, this means it is not a  situation where there is no bargain  after all. This means they are saying  that under these conditions, we would  support Erdoğan's candidacy again.  Naturally, the following question comes  to mind. Does the democratization of  the country only happen when steps are  taken regarding the Kurdish issue? For  example, with the Istanbul Metropolitan  Municipality, the appointed trustees,  operations against opposition  municipalities, journalists in prison —while all this is happening and an  anti-democratic oppressive regime, an  authoritarian regime, continues across  the country, a signal of an alliance is  being given by Cengiz Çandar in these  conditions. An interesting move. Truly  interesting; he is speaking openly,  saying that for Erdoğan's candidacy  and a new constitution, the situation  could be considered. It is truly  interesting. Now, while he says that,  as I said, operations are continuing in  the west of Turkey as well. There is a  video, for example; take Esenyurt, you  know the Esenyurt Mayor was also  arrested. He was thrown into prison.  Now, an election for the acting mayor  was held there too. You know, throw the  mayor in jail. Transfer CHP members to  the AKP. Uh, detain and arrest enough  council members. Then, sit in the chair . The system works like this. Now,  there was such an election for acting  mayor in Esenyurt as well. The CHP  member won—the CHP acting mayor won.  Then look at the dialogue in the  council. >> There is no election that we have lost.  We had already won the election in the  3rd round. We will file an objection.  The election is ours; let it stay with  you for a week. No problem. While there  is no problem. Look, he says let it  stay with you for a week. Meaning, he  says we will file an objection anyway.  He is so confident that he is right.  It’s always been like that. When they  lose the election, they go to the  judiciary. The judiciary says the AKP  candidate won. That’s just how  democracy is in Turkey right now. So,  are we supposed to say yes to this? Are  we to reconcile with such a regime? I  mean, will a solution come from such a  process? Is this the kind of democracy  coming to the country? Is the Kurdish  issue to be solved this way? With  trustees. There’s a trustee in Mardin , too. The trustee in Esenyurt is  looting. Ahmet Özer cannot return to  his seat. Ahmet Türk is outside, in  Mardin. Why—actually, there is no  obstacle for him to be there, but it  continues this way. And while these  things are going on. While Eyüp Sultan , Ataşehir, Adalar, and Üsküdar  continue, there is also Cemil Tugay,  who did a 180. 180 Cemil. 180 Cemil's  statements continue. Now 180 Cemil has  spoken again. He said, "I was  practically labeled a traitor due to  the reactions to me joining the AKP."  he says. "They are saying things like'  they occupied Izmir '," he says. " People should be ashamed when saying  such things," he says. He said, "One  should be ashamed.""Ashamed" is  interesting. He addressed those who  voted for him. Cemil Tugay, "Why did  the people of Izmir vote for me? What  did you vote for me to do?""Was it not  for me to be the mayor? So, am I trying  to do something else? No." I mean, how  does a person suddenly become so  pro-AKP? It’s messing with our  intelligence; the capacity to mock our  minds just suddenly hits the peak.  It’s like an AKP supporter just pops  out from inside him. He said there is  nothing for Izmir to fear. Izmir will  continue to live as Izmir. To live as  what? People will continue their lives  as before. Good. God bless you, Mr.  Cemil. You won't beat us with a stick.  Meaning, you won't beat the people of  Izmir. There will be only one thing  that is different. They will now see  much faster and more intensive  municipal services. Investments will  come to the city. Many things will be  done. He is saying, Cemil Tugay is  confessing again. We talked about it  yesterday, too. He says I was in the  opposition, in the CHP, or I am  independent. I am in a new party. Back  then, Erdogan and Murat Kurum were not  providing us services. They were not  supporting us. Look at that confession,  isn't it? How terrible. It's very  terrible. I mean, Mr. Erdogan, he is  saying very strange things about you,  and Mr. Murat, he is also saying very  strange things about you. He is telling  you that you are a central,  authoritarian government that prevents  opposition municipalities from  providing services. He says that  services can only be provided in this  country once you switch to the AKP.  Aren't these very disastrous statements ? I mean, didn't Erdogan say in every  session that we support all  municipalities equally so they can  provide services? But Cemil Tugay says  that Erdogan and Murat Kurum—the AKP  government—are making moves to  prevent municipalities won by the  opposition from providing services. I  mean, the next step after this is  saying that Imamoglu was thrown into  prison for political reasons, which, as  you know, Cemil Tugay doesn't care  about. He doesn't care at all about his  friends thrown into prison; the mayor  of the party that threw his friends  into prison is who he joined. Lastly,  let me say this as well. Also, as you  know, Tayfun Kahraman is in prison; the  Constitutional Court decided that his  rights were violated, acknowledging the  need for a retrial, and published the  reasoned decision. So, Tayfun Kahraman  also said that he is impatiently  waiting for a retrial to prove his  innocence once the Constitutional  Court's reasoned decision is published  in the Official Gazette. There are so  many people, unfortunately, who are  paying a price for standing against  these injustices. On the other hand,  there are those joining the ranks of  the AKP. But you know, there is  absolutely no giving up. There is  absolutely no quitting. We continue to  believe in democracy to the very end.

items.transkript: İyi akşamlar. Vallah sözünüz varsa, e, bu memlekete ilişkiniz bir der ilişkin bir derdiniz varsa evde olabilirsiniz, stüdyoda olabilirsiniz. Bazen bir kameranız olur, bazen sadece bir eee kaleminiz olur. Mesela fiziki olarak da çok nerede olduğunuz eee değil ama nerede durduğunuz, neyin karşısında e durduğunuz. Biz o nedenle sorularımızla aynı yerde duruyoruz. Beraber eee yan yana duruyoruz. Bazen eee bu masada farklı masalarda 5 kişi olarak bazen 4 kişi kaldık. Eee bazen 3 kişi kaldık. Bazen iki kişi kaldık. Ama eee hep beraber eee yan yanaydık ve sözümüzü söylemeye devam ettik. Bugün de aynısını e yapacağız. Bu koltuk bugün boş olabilir ama o koltuğun sahibi tam karşımızda. Eee karşısında durdukları da aynı, yanında durdukları da aynı ve soruları da aynı olacak. Murat evden bağlanıyor. Ev hapsinde olduğu için, bileğinde, ayak bileğinde bir kelepçe olduğu için. Murat nasılsın? Zımba gibiyim. Her zaman olduğu gibi. Siz de iyisin. Gayet iyi gözüküyorsunuz burada. >> Yani evde olmayı tercih edeb bilirdik. Dilek de burada olmayı tercih ederdi diye tahmin ediyorum. >> Kesinlikle. Kesinlikle. >> Şimdi Murat niye eee işin ucu döndü dolaştı? sana, gazetecilere dokundu. >> Evet. Eee, Sayın Cumhurbaşkanı ve aynı zamanda, eee, AK Parti eee, Grup Başkan Vekili ve Grup Başkanı yapmış olduğu açıklamalarda bu fon soruşturmasının sonu nereye giderse gitsincak ve ortaya çıkarılacak demişti. Ahan da çıktı bize. Bize çıktı. eee işte Şaban Sevinç eee aynı zamanda Mustafa Balcı, eee İsmail Saymaz ve Murat Harel. Herhalde bu işin ucu bize çıktı. Başka kimseye çıkmadığına göre. Niye derseniz çünkü eee tabii ki ülkemizde eee 2 milyar TL 163 koyup 2 milyar TL kazananların ayağına kelepçe takılmayacak. Onlar cezaevine gönderilmeyecek. Onlarla ilgili bir yargılama veya soruşturma da yapılmayacak. Öyle şey olur mu? Öyle şey olur mu? Görülmüş mü Türkiye'de böyle bir şey? Tabii ki gazeteciler sorgulanacak. Çünkü niye? Vurun abalıya ülkede kime yapılır? Gazeteciye yapılır. Fon soruşturması olur, gazeteciye olur. Belediyelere operasyon olur, gazetecilere olur. Başka bir kriz olur, gazetecilere olur. Ne olursa olsun gazetecilere operasyon yapılıyor. Çünkü bu toplumun en zayıf ve en savunmasız ve arkasında hiç kimsenin bulunmadığı yegane meslek gazeteciler. Çünkü onların duymak istemediği şeyleri söyleyen gazeteciler. Çünkü onların yazılmasını istemediği şeyleri yazan gazeteciler. Onların araştırılmasını istemediklerinin araştıran gazeteciler. Çünkü halkın sesine ses olan gazeteciler. Susturulmalı bunlar. Rimiharı susturulmalı. Ben Ömer Polat'tan özür dilerim. Ticaret bakanında. Ben onu aslında neden ismini dile getiriyorsun ki? Özür dilerim. Yani bir gazeteci olarak Türkiye Büyük Millet Meclisi kürsüsünden bakın kahvehane köşesinden demiyorum size. Pazara gittiğinizde oradaki sohbetten elde ettiğiniz bir bilgiyi demiyorum size. items.name: Yılmaz Özdil
items.title: Kılıçdaroğlu Halk TV'ye "Yalan Haber Yapıyor" Dedi! - Yılmaz Özdil
items.transkript: Hello. Today, we will talk about 4  cautionary statements from our  street-market style political scene.  Cautionary. Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu made  the first cautionary statement. He  targeted Halk TV by name. He said Halk  TV broadcasts fake news 24 hours a day.  Why isn't the owner of Halk TV in  Turkey? He asked in which country in  the world does a television channel  operate in its own country while its  owner is in a foreign land. Kemal  Kılıçdaroğlu. Halk TV owner Cafer  Mayiroğlu made the second cautionary  statement. Regarding Kılıçdaroğlu,  he called him "a person who conducts  sinister operations with roving  slanderers and trolls from an office  whose rent is paid by unknown parties  from unknown sources." And he also told  Kılıçdaroğlu that he is "the most  unfortunate incident that has ever  befallen Turkish politics." Özgür  Özel made the 3rd cautionary statement . In the same statement, he mentioned  telling Özgür Özel not to nominate  Cemil Tugay, while Özgür Özel called  Kılıçdaroğlu a disgraceful liar.  The 4th cautionary statement came from  İzmir Metropolitan Mayor Cemil Tugay,  who joined the AKP. He called Tayyip  Erdoğan a paternal figure. Yes. He  said he is a kind-hearted person. We  felt a sense of closeness between us.  He stated that he trusts him deeply,  even more than just believing in him.  Four cautionary statements. Like the  Rabia, you know. Four cautionary  statements. We will discuss them one by  one today. Unfortunately, an  unsurprising development occurred in  the Fonzi affair. They baited the  opposition with false information. And  the opposition jumped right onto the  hook. Two journalists were arrested.  Two journalists were placed under house  arrest. We will talk about this today  as well. But first, While Turkey's  agenda is occupied with street-market  politics and people are distracted all  day with such nonsense, there are very  important news items being overlooked.  Before getting to the Kılıçdaroğlu,  Halk TV, and Fonzi issues, I want to  talk a bit about these very important  news items that I believe are being  missed. The first one happened in  Başakşehir, Istanbul. As you know, a  15-year-old high school girl, a female  student, burst into an Imam Hatip  middle school—which she had no  connection to—with a knife in her  hand. Wearing her school uniform, she  randomly stabbed 8 students. One,  unfortunately, lost their life. A 10- year-old girl lost her life, for no  reason, completely innocent. The 15- year-old female attacker, along with  her mother and father, were arrested.  As far as our dear media, busy with  street-market politics, is concerned,  it happened and passed; it’s already  forgotten. But this subject is actually  very important. It is a very sensitive  issue. This 15-year-old attacking girl  was actually studying at an Anatolian  High School in Küçükçekmece. Her  grade point average was 96 out of 100.  She had actually qualified for a  science high school. She enrolled in  the Anatolian High School because it  was close to her home. It is stated  that she has no prior criminal record.  So, it is an incredibly strange attack.  As reflected in the media, her mother's  statements came out. She had been  subjected to peer bullying on the  grounds that she was ugly. She was  experiencing psychological problems  regarding this, and so on. And before  this attack, this is the exact point I  want to emphasize. This 15-year-old  attacking girl was browsing certain  sites and Telegram groups on the  internet before this knife incident.  That’s how it was reported. Just like  who, exactly? Like the attack in  Kahramanmaraş. Yes. Let’s remember,  please. In Kahramanmaraş, a 14- year-old middle school student raided a  school with 5 pistols and 7 magazines.  He killed 8 students and a teacher. He  wounded 17 students. Then he took his  own life. He died. You know, just like  now, his parents had been arrested back  then too. Look, we’ve already  forgotten about that news. You remember , don't you? We see the criminal  results, we experience them, and we are  shaken when we first hear about them.  But we never talk about the causes of  these criminal results. Instead of  covering them up with broadcasting bans , we need to inform the public. We need  to educate and warn parents. Especially  our teachers have a huge responsibility . We need to warn them. Look, why do I  say the stabbing attack in Başakşehir  is just like the massacre in  Kahramanmaraş? Because after it was  all over in that massacre, it emerged  that the 14-year-old student who  committed it had Elliot Rodger's photo  on his WhatsApp profile. Who is Elliot  Rodger? The person they promoted as President  is this man. Now, wasn't it Kemal  Kılıçdaroğlu whom Cafer Mahiroğlu  called "the most unfortunate incident  to happen to Turkish politics"? When we , at the risk of being stoned by the  people we were fighting for, at the  risk of burning our careers, and by  defending the honor of the pen, told  the story of the cuckoo operation— when we told how Turkey's founding  party, the Republican People's Party,  was taken over by cuckoo eggs—weren't  Halk TV commentators desperately  defending this very person who runs  insidious organizations with his mobile  slanderers and trolls? Cafer Mahiroğlu  says, "When Kılıçdaroğlu returned  to power via a nullity decision, I  terminated the contract with the CHP."  That's true. "I stopped invoicing the  CHP." Isn't it Cafer Mahiroğlu who  says, "Because I no longer do their  broadcasts"? Isn't this journalism for  money? It means, "If I get paid, I will  broadcast; since I'm not getting paid,  I won't broadcast you anymore.""I have  a commercial engagement with the CHP,  not an ideological one." Can it be  considered oppositional journalism to  say, "I can make commercial agreements  with other parties if necessary"? After  Özgür Özel came to the management of  the CHP, I changed and renewed the  contract. We made a new contract with  the CHP in January 2024. The new  contract became 1.5 million liras per  month. The dollar exchange rate that  day was 29.66 liras. The monthly  invoice issued to the CHP was  approximately $ 50,000. Then the parity  changed. Isn't it Cafer Mahiroğlu who  says the dollar equivalent decreased?  He explained it himself. Go online and  read the interview. Now, doesn't one  naturally wonder? How much money is the  New Party paying Halk TV? Are they  broadcasting for charity? Isn't that so ? I mean, one also wonders this. Since  Cafer Mahiroğlu, as he himself stated,  has established a commercial engagement  with parties rather than an ideological  one, if he terminates his contract with  the new party, how will Halk TV  broadcast about the New Party? Isn't  that so? or questions like these come  to mind. Now the owner of Halk TV says  it openly. He says the state also knows . He says my accounts are transparent.  He says let the state audit me. He says  I stated it there too. He says I issue  invoices. I broadcast their rallies,  their group meetings. I get money in  return. I issue an invoice. We submit  this to the state. We pay the taxes for  this. True. Then this comes to mind. Do  all those who broadcast Özgür Özel's  or Kılıçdaroğlu's group meetings,  who broadcast their rallies, receive  money? For example, how will we confirm  this? Or let's put it this way, for  example, why aren't the Good Party's  rallies broadcast? Because they don't  pay money. For example, there is no  news at all about the Victory Party.  Why? Because they don't pay money. Good  Party, Victory Party, I don't know,  Felicity Party, Workers 'Party do they  need to pay money to get into the news?  One was paying money, the other was  receiving money. They were doing just  fine. Now that the one paying the money  has changed, what happened?  Kılıçdaroğlu says, "Halk TV  broadcasts fake news 24 hours a day."  He says, where else in the world is it  seen for a television station to have  its owner in a foreign country and  broadcast in its own country, and so on . And what does Cafer Mahiroğlu say  about Kılıçdaroğlu, whom he  wouldn't let a speck of dust touch  during the contract periods? He calls  him a person who conducts insidious  organizations. He says with his roving  slanderers and trolls, and he is right.  Because they also paid money from the  CHP coffers to slanderous trigger  journalists and troll armies. Both  Kılıçdaroğlu and Özgür Özel paid . Cafer Mahiroğlu knows this very well , too. What does he say? He calls him a  person who conducts insidious  organizations with roving slanderers  and trolls. He says you are an  unfortunate event that should never  have happened to Turkish politics. But  they were fine during the contract  period. These are actually cautionary  tales. Look, life definitely tells the  story. Life tells what we fail to tell  in a cautionary way. From whom did  another cautionary statement come? It  came from Özgür Özel. What does the  New Party Chairman say? He calls  Kılıçdaroğlu a shameful liar. Now,  when we said "this won't work with  Kılıçdaroğlu, brother," Özgür  Özel used to lecture us. He would say,  "Scratch the surface of those who  criticize Kılıçdaroğlu, and either  an AKP supporter or an AKP troll will  come out." He calls us AKP trolls. What  is he saying now? He calls  Kılıçdaroğlu a liar. You must have  followed it. Kılıçdaroğlu went on  KRT television just recently. Along  with this Halk TV issue, he says that  during the 2023 CHP chairmanship  handover ceremony, he warned Özgür  Özel not to nominate Cemil Tugay—who  has now switched to the AKP—for any  district, let alone as the Mayor of  Izmir Metropolitan Municipality. And  what does Özgür Özel say in response  to this? He says, "I would be ashamed  to call a chairman a liar, but I have  never heard such a shameful lie." He  calls this a shameful lie. Now, first  of all, When did the news first break  that Kılıçdaroğlu warned Özgür  Özel about four mayors, including  Cemil Tugay, saying, "Don't ever make  them candidates"? Look, it came out a  year ago, in November 2025, right? Yes.  Who reported that news? Did  Kılıçdaroğlu say it? No. I won't  mention names and offend them, but  journalists who support Özgür Özel  reported it. Yes. Friends who appear on  Halk TV and Sözcü television reported  this news a year ago. It was even  reported on Halk TV under the headline  "Kılıçdaroğlu's Blacklist." This  news was from a year ago. The names of  the four mayors were also written down.  Let's not count them now so they don't  get offended. One of them was Cemil  Tugay. Hey, this news was reported a  year ago, and in this one year, the  same news was repeated and commented on  screen over and over again. In this one  year, did Özgür Özel come out even  once and say, "No, that didn't happen"?  He did not. For instance, did he deny  these reports by journalists close to  him? No, he never denied them. For  example, did he warn the friends who  reported this, saying, "Hey friends,  that's not how it happened, correct  this news"? Did he say that? No, he  didn't. He didn't. For a year. Now  Cemil Tugay has switched to the AKP.  Kılıçdaroğlu also spoke in this  context. He stated that during the CHP  Chairman's handover ceremony, he warned  Özgür Özel not to renominate Cemil  Tugay. Suddenly, Özgür Rezal came out  and denied it. He said, "I have never  heard such a shameful lie." The man  said he never heard it at all. He said,  "I have never heard such a lie." Yet,  I'm telling you, please go on the  internet and look. The reports are  still there. The subject that Özgür  Özel says he has "never heard such a  shameful lie about" has been in the  news for a year. Moreover, it is being  reported on Halk TV and Sözcü. Mr.  Özgür hasn't heard it at all. When  Özgür Özel says, "I have never heard  such a shameful lie," do any of the  opposition journalist friends who have  been reporting this news since a year  ago and commenting on it repeatedly for  a year come out and say, "How could you  not have heard it?" Do they? When  Özgür Özel calls Kılıçdaroğlu a  shameful liar, he is actually calling  the journalists who support him  shameful liars. And unfortunately, none  of those friends can come out and say,  "It's not a lie, we reported that news. " This is the pathetic situation of the  contract journalist. He who pays the  piper calls the tune. They blow the  whistle when told to blow. When they  are not supposed to blow, they swallow  the whistle to avoid accidentally  blowing it while breathing. 4. As for  the statement, Izmir Metropolitan Mayor  Cemil Tugay, who resigned from the CHP  and joined the AKP, says, "Oh, I  couldn't finish praising our leader of  the century." He said Tayyip Erdoğan  is a fatherly man. He said he is a  kind-hearted person. A sense of  intimacy has formed between us. He says  he trusts him even beyond believing in  him. When you listen to this "fatherly"  talk, you'd think our leader of the  century is someone like Hulusi Kentmen!  Yeah, I don't know about you; look,  when someone is called fatherly,  kind-hearted, or when there's talk of  intimacy, I always think of Hulusi  Kentmen first. Yeah, isn't that right?  Everyone's favorite, a Yeşilçam  legend...In all his movies, he  supposedly has a serious temperament;  with his giant build, thick mustache,  stern gaze, that resonant voice, and  his iconic style; like his dressing  gown, right? But he is actually not at  all who he appears to be on the outside . He is a man as soft as cotton.  Soft-hearted. Always fatherly. Always  compassionate. He pretends to yell and  scold like this. But in reality, he  can't bear to hurt anyone. Whether he's  playing a factory owner, a judge, or a  commissioner. He is always  conscientious. Always merciful. Who  wouldn't want a grandfather like Hulusi  Kentmen? Now, listening to Cemil Tugay,  you'd think our leader of the century  is Hulusi Kentmen. He's such a fatherly  man, apparently. Brother, just this  month, in October, in just 10 days, the  Mersin Metropolitan Mayor was arrested.  The Mezitli Mayor was arrested. The  Yenişehir Mayor was arrested. In  Istanbul, the Eyüp Sultan Mayor was  arrested. The Ataşehir Deputy Mayor  was arrested. On that occasion, the  Ataşehir Municipality was handed over  to the AKP. Operations were carried out  on the Bayraklı and Çeşme  municipalities in İzmir. And two  journalists who have supported Cemil  Tugay for years were arrested.  Electronic ankle monitors were placed  on the two journalists, and they were  put under house arrest. These things  have been happening in the last 10 days . What is Cemil Tugay still saying? He  says Tayyip Erdoğan is a very fatherly  man. Brother, İzmir hasn't seen anyone  like this Cemil Tugay since it became  İzmir. Now please look. It was written  that this Cemil Tugay first resigned  from the CHP, then went to the palace,  and then switched to the AKP. Isn't  that right? That is true, but  incomplete. He went on Umrah before he  even resigned from the CHP. Yes. He  went on Umrah first. May God accept it.  But that’s all his Umrah amounted to.  He used to say he didn't find changing  parties ethical. He said a mayor who  changes parties should also resign from  their mayorship. He said changing  parties was like changing one's family.  He used to ask, "Does a person change  their family?" He said if he switched  to the AKP, his inner circle wouldn't  look him in the face. He said his and  his family's worldview didn't align  with the AKP. He said if I switch to  the AKP, my mother will disown me.  That's what he said himself. That's  what he was saying. If I switch to the  AKP, my wife will divorce me. I'm  saying. That's what my wife said. He  says these things, and then he went on  Umrah. Then, click. Brother, İzmir  hasn't seen anyone like this since it  became İzmir. Yeah. Tayyip Erdoğan,  as the AKP chairman, is not the CHP's  president—he is not the president for  all. I mean, we love our president.  That’s separate. I am talking about  AKP Chairman Tayyip Erdoğan. He says  whatever comes to his mouth about CHP  leaders. For instance, he makes Hitler  comparisons to the second leader of the  CHP. Doesn't he? What did he say about  the 3rd leader of the CHP? Pathetic,  old, physically collapsed. Look,  everything is starting to break and  fall apart. It is now held together by  steel corsets. He had said that  postponing death does not mean life is  being lived. The CHP's 4th...what did  he call the chairman? He called him a  virus, ugly, base, immoral, mud, gang  lawyer, mafia lawyer, and a lawyer for  unlawful organizations. The CHP's 5th ...what did he call the chairman? He  called him spineless, an ill-fated  nomad, dirty-lipped, a puppet of  Pennsylvania, a partner of Qandil, a  friend of the murderer Assad, a DHKP-C  lawyer, a bloodthirsty coup plotter,  heartless, degenerate, a drug addict,  incompetent, shallow, a schizophrenic  type, dishonorable, and a political  pervert, didn't he? Why, he even calls  the CHP dung. He says their history is  stained like dung. He says they are  spineless. They have a tarnished record . They designed Ankara without the call  to prayer. They are fascists. Sewer pit , dross, garbage, dump, a filthy  mentality, are these not the main  betrayals? What is Cemil Tugay saying?  He says Tayyip Erdoğan is a very  fatherly person. A very kind-hearted  person. He is not at all how he appears . A sense of closeness has formed  between us. Since İzmir has been  İzmir, it has never seen anyone like  this Cemil Tugay. By the way, look, in  my Friday broadcast, I explained that  Özgür Özel unfortunately sees İzmir  as spoils of war. I said he couldn't  interfere with İstanbul because he  couldn't handle Ekrem İmamoğlu,  couldn't interfere with Ankara because  he couldn't get the better of Mansur  Yavaş, but that he sees İzmir as loot  for himself and has set his sights on  it. Do you know what an İzmir deputy,  who is now in the New Party but was in  the CHP back then and is brought onto  the screen by the so-called opposition  media, had said? Look, he had called  the İzmir chairman "right of the sword ." Everyone knows the meaning of "right  of the sword." This is exactly the work  of those who look at İzmir as "right  of the sword." Cemilay. Since İzmir  has been İzmir, I have never seen  anyone like this. That's it for today.  Please do not neglect to subscribe,  like, comment, and share. The biggest  family in the world. We are heading  toward 800,000 subscribers. By the way,  I said it on Friday. The person at the  top of German intelligence, August  Hunning, who served as BND chief  between 1998 and 2005, was arrested for  espionage and treason. An extraordinary  thing for Germany. For the world, man.  This has an unbelievable connection to  Turkey. I was going to explain this  today, but I couldn't fit it into  today's broadcast. In a way you haven't  heard anywhere else so far, this is all . I will hold a raffle among my  subscribers. On the occasion of Cemil  Tugay calling our leader fatherly, I  will send Hulusi Kentmen movies to the  mobile phones of 10 lucky viewers. Yes,  you will watch them. You will remember  Cemil Tugay and laugh your heads off.  See you on Friday morning. Farewell. M
